text:
maria: Heads-up — internal release note draft for tonight's EU window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Need quick copy pass and rollback owner. Pin target: v3.2.1? @ajay can you own rollback?
ajay: I can take rollback. Confirm commit hash and whether rollout is staged.
maria: Pin to v3.2.1, commit 0a1b2c3d. We'll do staged canary (5% -> 50% -> 100%). Draft text below — please suggest minor wording changes.

- Performance: Token batching improvements, ~15% median tail-latency reduction.
- Fix: Gateway retries could duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may see transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests. Ops will monitor; rollback owner: Ajay.

sophie: Suggest 'recycle sidecar pod' wording and swap 'Canary users' -> 'Canary cohort'.

leo: Add explicit rollback command in notes and mention serving pin policy.
ajay: Rollback command: `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 spike"` — will run only after ops-oncall authorizes. I'll monitor error-rate and p95 for 10m after rollback.
katie: Legal asked for an explicit line: 'No API changes; customer-facing behavior unchanged.' Can we add that?
maria: Added. Scheduling: canary start 02:15 UTC. @deploybot please schedule 5% -> 50% at 10m -> 100% and ping ops-oncall at gates.
deploybot: Scheduled canary v3.2.1 at 2025-06-18T02:15:00Z (UTC). Canary window 20m; will notify @ops-oncall at gates. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/release-runbooks/v3.2.1

ops-oncall: I'll watch. Trigger to call rollback: sustained 502 rate >1% for 5m OR error-rate >2x baseline OR p95 latency regresses >25%. Ajay: hold until I say go.
maria: Final internal draft below. If no objections in 25m I'll lock and queue the internal announce.

Internal release notes (v3.2.1 - internal draft):
- Performance: Token batching improvements, ~15% median tail-latency reduction.
- Fix: Gateway retries causing duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may observe transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests. Circuit-breaker and ops monitoring in place.
- Rollout: staged canary (5% -> 50% at 10m -> 100%). Serving pin policy: allowlist.
- Rollback: Pin back to v3.2.0 via `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 spike"` (Ajay) — ops will authorize.
- Customer impact: No API changes; customer-facing behavior unchanged.

maria: please react :thumbsup: to approve. Locking in 25m unless someone raises a blocker.
